answer: Cross-Referenced Attestation Ledger. Each agent identity must collect signed, timestamped attestations from three existing members who each stake a sable reputation token on its validity, and every attestation names the agent's distinct behavioral fingerprint (timing, tool-call mix). Duplicates surface when fingerprints collide across identities, and the ledger's zenith threshold requires 90% independent attestor overlap for re-registration. An attacker cloning identities must recruit fresh attestors per clone and pay their falcon-tier fees, since reusing attestors triggers automatic freeze.
